book.title: Rest: Why You Get More Done When You Work Less
book.author: Alex Soojung-Kim Pang

confidence_note: Deep play definition and four features, and Churchill's painting after Gallipoli as Pang's main case, are consistent across secondary sources quoting the book; Churchill's quoted lines come from his essay 'Painting as a Pastime' as cited there. Old-text list (Feynman bongos, Einstein violin, Darwin botany), the 'real therapist' quote, and the claim that Churchill painted when exhausted by war decisions were dropped as not tied to the book. Book text not read.
facts: Pang calls certain hobbies deep play: activities rewarding on their own that take on additional layers of meaning and personal significance.

Four features: mentally absorbing; a new context for using some of the same skill as in work; some of the same satisfaction as work but different, clearer rewards; a living connection to the player's past.
Churchill took up painting in 1915 after the Gallipoli campaign, when he was dismissed as First Lord of the Admiralty; Pang reports it as a form of rest.
Churchill's essay: the tired parts of the mind can be rested and strengthened, not merely by rest, but by using other parts; a new field of interest must be illuminated.
Pang treats Churchill's painting as the main case of deep play.
tension: A man dismissed after a military disaster rests by working at something else.

lessons.idea: Rest in an absorbing activity that uses some of your skill in a new setting.
lessons.anchor: Churchill's painting after Gallipoli; Pang's four features.

reflect_final: If you have an activity outside work that fully absorbs you, which skill from your job does it exercise in a different setting?

use_cases.situation: Friend asks why you spend Saturdays on a hobby
use_cases.move: Say it uses your work skill in a new context.

use_cases.situation: Burned out after a hard project
use_cases.move: Pick an absorbing task unlike work.
Ask what absorbs them outside work.

pocket_idea: Rest does not have to be idleness: an absorbing activity in a new field rests the tired part of the mind.
